card.name: Words inside dosing and handling instructions
card.fires_on: Varied words in the middle of drug-label instructions on dosing, administration, missed doses and device handling. Examples are the end of a brand name, a linking word like from, within or during, or part of the word dosage.

modes.label: Inside dosing words
modes.description: Partway through dose or dosage terms in schedules and missed-dose directions.

modes.description: Small connecting words or commas inside administration and timing directions.
